latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Nex Timetrack 1.0.0

- Billable time tracker for freelancers/agencies; manage clients, projects, and rates.
- Live timer and manual log entries, with 15-minute optional rounding.
- Supports client/project/entry-level rate overrides and billing summaries.
- Full-text search, CSV/JSON export, and usage statistics.
- Python standard library only; all data stored locally in SQLite.
- Natural language commands and ClawdBot integration for ease of use.
